R1D-bear-walk-0004.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R1D-bear-walk-0004.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2017 (9 years old), 180 m SW: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2017 (fire V91631), 20 m SW: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
W facing slope, 30 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).
